answer_1.quote: We randomly select 1000 images from the val2014 subset in MSCOCO dataset and query LLaVA-1.5 with the prompt "What can you see in this image ?" to get the descriptions from model. ... We use the generated captions and object words as two kinds of units and employed CHAIR to identify hallucinations.
answer_1.outputs: image captions, question‑answer responses, descriptive texts

answer_2.quote: We use CHAIR, POPE, MME and GPT-4V‑aided evaluation to assess hallucination and overall performance of the LVLMs.

answer_3.quote: The GPT-4V‑aided evaluation employs GPT-4V as an evaluator to compare the outputs of two LVLM assistants. GPT-4V assigns scores out of 10 based on two criteria: 1) accuracy, which measures how accurately each assistant describes the image, and 2) detailedness, which evaluates the richness of necessary details in the responses.
